scope: Isolated opt-in copy only. Live AOS source, service, DB and runtime were not modified. Lab production API was not modified.
package_gate_result: PASS: 3838 package checks. No model/runtime/training tests were run.
implementation_summary: Strict bounded Lab request/status/report models; loopback-only HTTP; token file O_NOFOLLOW/owner/mode checks; strict JSON UUID parsing and canonical report SHA verification.
Detached /api/lab start/status/stop/report routes; never call DesktopScheduler; database writes remain on AOS event-loop thread while only HTTP runs in asyncio.to_thread.
AOS SQLite migration maps external job ids to actual AOS tasks/runs/steps/actions and terminal verification; per-session namespaced remote idempotency prevents cross-session key collision.

Start and stop acknowledgements are followed by status observation; terminal status requires matching run identity, inner report run_id, terminal status, and report hash. Delayed nonterminal replies cannot regress a verified terminal state.
Report HTTP envelope cap is 256 KiB; ordinary control responses remain capped at 64 KiB. Larger report suites need pagination or an explicit bounded-size policy.
explicit_open_gaps: Current Lab API still hardcodes origin=local and does not accept the authenticated AOS service-principal identity or external job/task binding. Prototype deliberately requires status origin=aos, so it is not live-compatible until Lab-side identity binding is implemented.
AOS typed HTTP task route is separate from ComputerGateway/MCP tool catalog; no claim of model/tool catalog integration.
Queued API response is dispatch acknowledgement, not research completion; no durable dispatcher/worker binding to Lab CLI run profile yet.
No actual AOS service/database route test or shared GPU/CPU/RAM coexistence acceptance; ASGI fixture + private SQLite and Lab fake are isolated tests.
Actual TrajectoryStore restart with an active external job currently raises Unknown run because typed runtime state is missing; see aos-store-restart-before.json.
current_lab_api_compatibility: blocked: deployed Lab API returns origin=local; this isolated AOS prototype requires origin=aos before it accepts run status.
